item.title: Hash House Harriers trails 2021
item.description:
The (LH3) run weekly all over London. Using GPS data from Strava, I have created a map (below) showing the routes run so far this year.

Due to Covid-19 lockdown restrictions, we were only able to begin running again in April, and even these runs were socially distanced (no running the trail in a big group, no pub at the end). As restrictions are eased we hope to get back to the traditional hashing format soon.

item.title: Hash trails 2020
item.description:
Several groups run all over London each week. Each week the location of the trails varies as that week’s “hare” lays the trail in an area they know well. I have been collecting the GPS routes of the trails from Strava for each group and plotting them on a map using Python.

If you are interested in running/drinking with one of the Hashes, check our when and where upcoming hash trails will be on the or the .

Most recent trails

The map below shows the trails run over the last week (or so) by the various Hash House Harrier groups around London. You can zoom in on the map, and click on the location icon to get details of which group each trail belongs to.
